security.title: Password Generator
security.description: Create passwords with operating-system cryptographic randomness and check how difficult they are to guess, all in your browser.
security.analysisDescription: Your input is not sent anywhere.
security.guessHelp: Each additional bit roughly doubles the number of guesses required.
security.crackHelp: Assumes an attacker can try 10 billion guesses per second after a password-hash leak.
security.adviceWeak: Use a longer, unique combination instead of common words, repetition or sequences.
security.adviceMedium: This may be usable, but a longer password without predictable names or dates is safer.

guide.title: Password generator guide
guide.description: Passwords use secure randomness supplied by your operating system and are not sent to a server.

blocks.title: Long and unique
blocks.text: Use a different password of at least 16 characters for each service and keep it in a password manager.

blocks.title: Strength score
blocks.text: The score considers common words, repetition, sequences and estimated guesses. It cannot check breach history or multi-factor authentication.

blocks.title: Estimated cracking time
blocks.text: This comparison assumes a leaked password hash and 10 billion guesses per second. Actual time depends heavily on how a service stores passwords and protects accounts.

faq.q: Is the generated password saved?
faq.a: No. It disappears when you leave this page.

faq.q: Is the estimated cracking time a guarantee?
faq.a: No. It is a comparison estimate. Rate limits, password storage and multi-factor authentication change real attack conditions.

faq.q: Is a copied password safe?
faq.a: Other apps may read the clipboard. After use, copy something else to overwrite it.

faq.q: Does this run SQL?
faq.a: No. It formats text without connecting to a database.

faq.q: Does it repair invalid JSON?
faq.a: No. To avoid silently changing data, it reports the error instead.

faq.q: Can it handle large CSV files?
faq.a: Processing runs separately within your browser's memory limit. Hundreds of thousands of rows may take time depending on file size and device memory.

faq.q: Are scripts inside HTML executed?
faq.a: No. Only table-cell text is extracted; the input HTML is never inserted into the page or executed.

faq.q: Are pasted text or TXT files uploaded?
faq.a: No. Content is not sent to a server or saved in browser storage. It is merged only on the current page.

faq.q: Can pasted text be placed between TXT files?
faq.a: Yes. Every item uses the same list, so pasted text and TXT files can be mixed in any order.

faq.q: Does editing loaded TXT content change the original file?
faq.a: No. Only the current card and merged result change. The original file remains untouched.

faq.q: Which TXT encoding is supported?
faq.a: UTF-8 TXT files are supported. If text looks corrupted, save the original as UTF-8 and load it again.

blocks.title: Korean guide

faq.q: Is my document text saved?
faq.a: No. Input is not stored on a server or in browser storage.

faq.q: Should I apply every suggestion?
faq.a: No. Korean has contextual exceptions, so compare each suggestion with the original.

faq.q: Is this the same as leave paid on termination?

faq.q: Can I use this for a tax filing?

blocks.title: What is EXIF?
blocks.text: A camera or phone may store extra data such as device details, date and GPS location inside the photo file, even though it is not visible in the image.

blocks.title: How removal works
blocks.text: Instead of copying the original file structure, the browser redraws only the pixels and saves a new JPG, PNG or WebP file. Extra data such as EXIF is left behind.

blocks.title: Image quality
blocks.text: JPG and WebP are re-encoded, so quality and file size may change slightly. PNG is saved without lossy compression.

faq.q: Does this modify the original photo?
faq.a: No. You download a new copy with hidden data removed.

faq.q: What is metadata?
faq.a: It is information attached to a file in addition to its visible content. This tool inspects EXIF fields including GPS, device and capture time.

faq.q: Is HEIC supported?
faq.a: No. JPG, PNG and WebP are supported; HEIC and HEIF are not.

guide.title: Excel merge guide
guide.description: Understanding format-specific formula and formatting settings and merge layouts helps produce the expected result.

blocks.title: Supported file formats
paragraphs: You can combine XLSX, XLS, XLSB, XLSM and CSV files. The result is always XLSX.
items: XLSX: preserve formulas and common cell formatting independently
XLS: standard mode converts values and basic structure; formulas and formatting can be selected independently for higher fidelity
XLSB and XLSM: values and basic sheet structure are converted
CSV: handled as one table of values

blocks.title: XLSX formula and formatting settings
paragraphs: Formula preservation and formatting preservation for XLSX input are independent. Turning formulas off copies stored calculation results. Turning formatting off omits cell appearance, row and column layout, and merged regions. These settings apply to the current files without an extra download or page reload.

blocks.title: XLS formula and formatting settings
paragraphs: Turning on either XLS formula or formatting preservation opens the same merge interface with the browser conditions needed to convert XLS into a compatible XLSX structure first. The first actual XLS selection downloads about 250 MB of additional files and later tasks can reuse them. Turning both options off returns to the standard screen. A screen transition clears selected files.

blocks.title: Choosing sheets
paragraphs: After adding files, choose all sheets, a shared position rule, or a custom selection for each file.

blocks.title: Choosing a merge layout
paragraphs: Separate sheets keeps each source sheet. Vertical appends rows; horizontal appends columns.
items: Same columns, such as monthly records: vertical
Same rows, such as category records: horizontal

blocks.title: Formulas, passwords and verification
paragraphs: When formulas are preserved, relative references are adjusted as rows or columns move in vertical and horizontal merges. Input and output passwords remain only in browser memory during the task. Password-protected legacy XLS may need an unlocked copy before preservation conversion.
Charts, images, external connections, pivots and some advanced table objects can be omitted or simplified. Review important output in Excel.

blocks.title: Trimming empty areas
paragraphs: Ending trim excludes unused space after content. Consecutive-empty removal scans the completed output and removes middle groups that meet the threshold.
items: Rows and columns can be selected independently
Groups shorter than the threshold remain

faq.q: Can XLSX formulas and formatting be preserved separately?
faq.a: Yes. Turn formula and formatting preservation on or off independently under XLSX input. Neither option needs an extra download or page reload.

faq.q: Can XLS formulas and formatting be preserved separately?
faq.a: Yes. Turn on only the options you need under XLS input. Either option opens the matching preservation screen, and the first XLS selection prepares about 250 MB of additional files.

faq.q: Why does changing XLS preservation reload the page?
faq.a: The browser conditions required for higher-fidelity XLS conversion must be prepared safely. Selected files are cleared when preservation is first enabled or both options are disabled, so review the notice before switching.

faq.q: Are CSV formulas and styles preserved?
faq.a: No. CSV stores plain values only. The combined result uses XLSX so it can hold richer spreadsheet features.

faq.q: Can XLSB and XLSM files be merged?
faq.a: Yes, but values and basic sheets are converted to XLSX. XLS preservation applies only to the legacy XLS format, and XLSM macros are excluded.

faq.q: Can I select the same sheet position from every file?
faq.a: Yes. Enter 2 for every second sheet. Rules such as -3, 3-, 1,3,5 and 2-4 also work.

faq.q: Can encrypted Excel files be merged?
faq.a: Supported Office encryption can be unlocked locally with the password. For high-fidelity preservation of a password-protected legacy XLS, use an unlocked copy.

guide.title: Audio waveform editing guide
guide.description: Selected audio and edit data remain in the current browser and are not sent to an external server.

blocks.title: Selecting a waveform region
blocks.text: Drag the waveform to create a purple selection. Move it, resize its handles, or enter start and end values with 1ms precision.

blocks.title: Sample-level editing
blocks.text: Mute sets selected samples to zero; Cut and Delete pull later samples forward. Paste inserts the memory clip at the red playback cursor.

blocks.title: Selected-region voice effects
blocks.text: Lower, higher and childlike presets shift pitch while preserving duration; Robot applies fast amplitude modulation. Preview only the selected region before applying it, and a short crossfade softens each boundary.

blocks.title: Keyboard shortcuts
blocks.text: Outside input fields, Space toggles playback. Ctrl+Z or Cmd+Z undoes; Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Y redo.

blocks.title: Undo and memory
blocks.text: Decoded PCM samples are retained per channel. History is limited automatically to at most 12 states and roughly 256MB, and is cleared with a new file.

blocks.title: WAV and MP3
blocks.text: WAV creates a compatible 16-bit uncompressed file quickly. Audio processing for MP3 export and pitch effects is prepared on first use, and the same editing screen avoids repeating that setup when possible.

blocks.title: Browser file support
blocks.text: Modern browsers normally open MP3 and WAV. M4A, AAC and OGG depend on operating-system and browser codec support.

faq.q: Is audio uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Opening, sample editing, preview and conversion all run in the current browser.

faq.q: Do lower and higher tone presets change gender?
faq.a: No. They do not identify or transform a person's gender; they only alter the selected region's pitch and tone.

faq.q: Where does Paste insert audio?
faq.a: At the current red playback cursor after you click or play through the waveform.

faq.q: Why do long files use so much memory?
faq.a: Compressed audio must be decoded to uncompressed per-channel samples, while preview data and undo states are also retained.

faq.q: Can MP3 export work offline?
faq.a: It may work if the encoder was cached before. On a first visit with no connection, use WAV instead.

faq.q: Does export overwrite the original?
faq.a: No. The original remains unchanged and a new WAV or MP3 is downloaded.

blocks.title: Unified image editor
blocks.text: Open a photo or blank canvas and use adjustments, drawing, text, shapes and searchable stickers in one history. Resize all content or just the canvas, and choose exact export dimensions. Use the mouse wheel to zoom, drag while holding Space to pan, or use two fingers on mobile to zoom and pan.

blocks.title: Region mosaic and blur
blocks.text: Drag over an area of the photo and adjust the effect strength. Effects use the original photo, so the last effect is visible where regions overlap and separately drawn lines or text are not affected. For sensitive information, prefer a strong mosaic over a weak blur and inspect the result at full size before downloading.

blocks.title: Batch processing
blocks.text: Add files or clipboard images, resize and watermark them, then bundle the results in a ZIP.

blocks.title: Collages and GIF
blocks.text: A scaled preview uses the same layout calculation as export. GIF's 256-color limit may simplify subtle gradients.

faq.q: Are images sent to a server?
faq.a: No. They are processed only in the current browser.

faq.q: Does this modify my originals?
faq.a: No. Every result is downloaded as a new file.

faq.q: Can content concealed with mosaic or blur be recovered?
faq.a: The downloaded PNG, JPG or WebP has the effect applied to the original photo pixels, so the previous pixels are not retained in that file. Before downloading, the current editing session can still undo the effect.

faq.q: Which formats are supported?
faq.a: Input supports JPG, PNG and WebP, not HEIC or HEIF. Output supports PNG, JPG, WebP and GIF.

faq.q: Can I keep transparency?
faq.a: PNG and WebP keep transparency; JPG turns it white.

faq.q: Why can large images stop?
faq.a: Browsers and devices have canvas and memory limits. Reduce output dimensions or file count.

blocks.title: Adding files and group outputs
paragraphs: Open the file picker or drop files repeatedly to append videos. Arrange them in up to 10 groups; each group can export individually or concatenate selected ranges. Results appear as they finish, and ZIP creation is optional. MP3 and AAC results can be sent directly to Audio Studio in a new tab.

blocks.title: Passthrough and trim accuracy
paragraphs: Passthrough is fast and lossless because it avoids re-encoding. The first audio track can be copied, removed, or converted. Incompatible source audio reports an error rather than changing quality silently. Trim starts may move to a nearby keyframe, and videos with different codecs or dimensions cannot be concatenated without re-encoding.

blocks.title: Bitrate and sample rate
paragraphs: Bitrate is data stored per second; higher values generally increase quality and file size. Sample rate is how often audio is sampled per second. Choose a preset or enter a custom value.

blocks.title: Synchronized playback and split fullscreen
paragraphs: Play videos in a group together and move them with one playhead. Split fullscreen lets you compare the group on one screen while listening to one selected video. Start and end ranges from one group can be applied at once to videos in the same card positions in other groups.

blocks.title: Large sources and output limits
paragraphs: Large source videos are not copied into memory all at once. Completed results and ZIP files are kept as temporary files in supported browsers, with the existing memory path used automatically when that is unavailable. Oversized passthrough estimates are reported before processing.

blocks.title: Input compatibility
paragraphs: MP4, MOV, and WebM usually preview in current browsers. If MKV or AVI preview fails, the tool separately reads duration and dimensions for numeric trimming, but not every internal compression format is guaranteed.

blocks.title: Using multiple CPU cores
paragraphs: Supported browsers process videos with multiple CPU cores. When this is unavailable, the tool automatically uses a functionally equivalent single-thread compatibility mode.

faq.question: Are videos sent to a server?
faq.answer: No. Selected files and results are processed only in this browser and are not sent to a server.

faq.question: How do I download group outputs?
faq.answer: Each completed file gets its own download button. You can also download all individually, save to a folder in supported browsers, or create an optional ZIP.

faq.question: Can I apply one group's ranges to other groups?
faq.answer: Yes. Select Apply ranges to other groups and choose the targets. Start and end times are copied between videos in the same card positions. If a target ends before the copied end time, its end point is set to the end of that video; if it also ends before the copied start time, it is left unchanged.

faq.question: Where do I select GIF or audio extraction?
faq.answer: Choose GIF, MP3, or AAC as the output format. Only the relevant settings appear, and MP3/AAC results can continue in Audio Studio.

faq.question: Can I keep or remove video audio?
faq.answer: Yes. Copy, remove, or convert the first audio track. Selecting among multiple audio tracks is not currently supported.

faq.question: Can videos concatenate without re-encoding?
faq.answer: Yes when video/audio codecs and dimensions are compatible. Otherwise the tool asks you to re-encode instead of silently changing quality.

faq.question: Why is the first run slow?
faq.answer: The video processing feature must be prepared the first time you use it. Later jobs may start faster once it is ready.

faq.question: Is remaining time for the whole job?
faq.answer: It is recalculated from the recent speed of the current video and encoding stage. A new input or final concat stage starts a fresh estimate.

faq.question: Do MKV and AVI always work?
faq.answer: No. When a browser cannot preview a file, the tool can often read its duration and dimensions separately, but unsupported compression combinations are not guaranteed.

organize.title: Edit, merge, and extract PDF pages
organize.description: Review pages visually, reorder, rotate, and select them, then export one PDF or several page ranges.

image-to-pdf.title: Convert images to PDF
image-to-pdf.description: Arrange JPG and PNG images and create a PDF fitted to A4 or sized to each original image.

pdf-to-image.description: Render every PDF page as PNG or JPG and download them in a ZIP archive.

convert.title: Convert PDF to DOCX, XLSX, or TXT
convert.description: Export embedded text and Korean/English OCR results as documents, spreadsheets, text, or a searchable PDF.

standard.title: Using the browser PDF tools
standard.description: Selected files stay in this browser's memory and are not uploaded to a processing server. Keep your originals and review every downloaded result.

blocks.title: Page-level editing
paragraphs: Drag previews to reorder pages and remove unwanted pages. For PDFs by range, choose a range in the output workspace on the right and use page checkboxes, or quickly split the document between pages.
If a source page is already rotated, your rotation is added to its existing orientation so the exported page matches the preview.

blocks.title: Local processing and file lifetime
paragraphs: PDFs, images, and download links live in browser memory. Refreshing or closing the tab clears the current selection and any undownloaded result.
The site, advertising, and OCR model assets may use ordinary network requests, but your work files are not sent to a conversion server.

blocks.title: Protected PDFs and signatures
paragraphs: Password-protected PDFs are not supported. Use a legitimately unlocked copy provided by the document owner.
Merging, rotating, splitting, or rebuilding a PDF invalidates existing digital signatures. Forms, bookmarks, links, attachments, and advanced objects may not survive page copying.

blocks.title: Quality and performance
paragraphs: Reordering and extracting pages normally copies original PDF pages rather than rasterizing them. Image conversion and searchable OCR PDFs render pages at the selected resolution.
More pages and higher resolution increase processing time, memory use, and output size. Previews render lazily at lower resolution to keep long documents responsive.

faq.question: Are files uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. Selected PDFs, images, and generated results are processed in this browser. The site, ads, and OCR assets may still make ordinary network requests.

faq.question: Can I process a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Not currently. The tool does not bypass protection; an authorized user must prepare an unlocked copy.

faq.question: Does it work on mobile?
faq.answer: Yes, but desktop browsers are more reliable for long PDFs, high-resolution rendering, and large OCR jobs because mobile memory is limited.

faq.question: Does rotation reduce PDF quality?
faq.answer: Page-editor rotation changes page properties without recompressing content. Image and OCR-PDF modes do rerender pages.

faq.question: How do I select multiple page ranges?
faq.answer: Choose the output range in the output workspace on the right and use each page checkbox. For a continuous document, mark split positions after pages to build all ranges at once. Number entry remains available for non-contiguous pages and custom ordering.

faq.question: Where do I download the finished PDF or ZIP?
faq.answer: Follow progress and download the completed file in the output workspace. On mobile, open it from the output button at the bottom of the screen.

faq.question: Can it perfectly restore Word or Excel structure?
faq.answer: Usually not. PDFs often lack the original paragraph and table structure, so the output is an editable reconstruction based on coordinates and spacing.

faq.question: Why is the first OCR run slower?
faq.answer: The browser must download language data for Korean and English recognition. Later runs can start faster while that data remains cached.

convert.title: PDF text conversion and browser OCR
convert.description: Selected files stay in this browser's memory and are not uploaded to a processing server. Keep your originals and review every downloaded result.

blocks.title: Text PDFs and scanned PDFs
paragraphs: Text PDFs contain selectable characters, so extraction is fast and accurate. Scanned PDFs store each page like a photo and require OCR.
Automatic OCR runs Korean and English recognition only on pages with little usable embedded text. A drawing or photo with no text may correctly produce an empty result.

blocks.title: DOCX and XLSX conversion limits
paragraphs: PDFs often preserve positions rather than the original paragraphs, tables, and cells. DOCX reconstructs lines as paragraphs, while XLSX estimates cells from spacing.
Complex tables, columns, vertical text, footnotes, formulas, fonts, and formatting may not be reproduced exactly. Treat the output as an editable draft and compare it with the source.

blocks.title: OCR data and privacy
paragraphs: Korean and English OCR and its language data are served from the same GitHub Pages deployment. No external OCR server or CDN receives your document pages.
OCR cannot start on a first offline visit or when the required OCR data is not cached. Reopen the site online after clearing storage, using private browsing, or running low on browser storage.

blocks.title: Large documents
paragraphs: OCR renders and recognizes pages one at a time, so it takes longer than embedded-text extraction. For 50+ pages, close heavy tabs and keep enough memory and power available.
Mobile operating systems may close memory-intensive tabs, so long documents are generally more reliable on a desktop browser.
